card.name: Inside brand and long medical names
card.fires_on: The middle or final piece of a split-up brand name or long medical term, such as the xin in Eulexin, the SO in ELELYSO, or the oh in Lymphohistiocytosis. It appears in drug label text.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: A late piece of a drug brand name, often followed by the registered mark or a treatment word.

modes.label: Long disease term
modes.description: The middle piece of the term hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

card.plain: It fires partway through unusual drug brand names and long disease names that are split into pieces.
